name: Projected Maximum Positive Degree of the Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Separation Class
proof: Projection to coordinates $\{1,2\}$ gives $\{01,10,11\}$, where $11$ has two smaller one-coordinate neighbours. Exhaustive enumeration verifies that no projection has larger maximum positive degree. See sync/verify_projected_positive_noclashing_gap.py.
